settings.content:
Pre-order cancellation

You may cancel an unshipped pre-order for a full refund by emailing [SUPPORT EMAIL] with your order number. Once an order has shipped, the standard return rules below apply.

Returns

We accept eligible return requests within [X] days of delivery. Products must be unopened, unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. Because supplements are ingestible goods, opened products cannot be returned unless defective, damaged, incorrect, or otherwise required by law.

Non-returnable items

Opened supplements, gift cards, sale/final-sale items [if legally permitted], and items outside the return window are not eligible unless required by law.

Damaged or incorrect orders

Contact us within [X] days of delivery at [EMAIL] with your order number and clear photos. We will review the issue and provide an appropriate replacement or refund.

Refund timing

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. Bank or card processing times may vary. Shipping charges are [refundable/non-refundable] except where required by law or where the error is ours.

Return shipping

[State who pays, how labels are issued, and the return address process]. Do not send products without authorization.
